notes.title: Further Education Episode 7 (v0.7) Released!
notes.content:
[h3]Now [b]THIS[/b] is the longest i've ever took to make an update, but putting this out there was an achievement in and of itself for me; through pain, illness, my money making machine almost exploding on me and so many geopolitical changes! (I live on a self sustaining island, I meant for the story's narrative hehe) but here it is!

[i]And I apologize for all my supporters on Steam, I was radio silent here- didn't post any updates or anything, I cannot promise frequent updates since I'm more focused with delivering the episodes than anything but here on out I'll make an effort of keeping everyone up-to-date!

[/i][b]Changelog[/b]:
- 3000+ renders
- 10+ self made assets (As a DAZ developer this is a big thing for me)
- Added major branch (Who chooses to confront in the diner matters from here on out)

notes.title: Further Education Episode 6 (v0.6) Release!
notes.content:
[h2]This is the longest I've taken to make an episode but think of it like digging deep into the earth to lay foundation, the new set of code I've put in expand the storytelling aspect much Further! (hehe).[/h2]

Okay so [h2]changelogs[/h2]-
- [b]1500+ renders[/b]
- [b]OMN1 Helper[/b] (Encyclopedia System)
- Previous parts overhauled and refined (typo and such, please feel free to let me know if any other changes are required.)
- SFXs (Experimental, again please let me know if you liked it or not)
- Game now rated fully [u][b]Adults-Only[/b][/u], please play again from beginning to see all the content!

Man, I'm going to step out of my cave now and meet with my tribespeople, they not seen my face in quite some time...

notes.title: Further Education Ep6 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellas!- It's finally done[/h1]

Through failed renders and massive wisdom tooth ache [u][b][u]EP6 is finally complete![/u][/b][/u] It’s [u]currently being playtested[/u] by a close friend of mine who’s had my back since day one. Once he gives me his feedback and the green light, I’ll release it!

[h1]🔧 Heads-Up:[/h1]

You’ll need to start a new game. I’ve completely torn apart the internal systems and rebuilt something way more expansive that will make the game much more capable of handling the story elements and things much more immersive!

[b]Old saves won’t be compatible[/b], but trust me, it’ll be worth it!

Thanks so much for your patience and your support- It means everything.
I can’t wait for you to try it.
